task_title: Fix Floor 2 settlement progression and HUD gating

plan_review.notes: Round 1 rejected one-phase Broker targeting: room-entry and intro are distinct, Track-B drift required suppression, SAFE retag forbids role lookup, broker fallback and real-artifact coverage were missing. Round 2 approved the two-phase plan with changes: neutral core anchor helper, split Floor-1 waypoint guard, highest-non-safety semantics, bounded phase-B fallback, and distinct phase-A marker/phase-B headless/HUD artifacts. Alternatives considered: room-anchor plus Broker phase, shared resolver, generic goal resolver, first-class meet-Broker quest, mutable critical-chain state, and live-Broker-only targeting.
